name: Horseshoe Spread
summary: A seven-card curved arch providing balanced insight into obstacles, hidden factors, and tactical approach.
author: Traditional

instructions.preparation: Visualize your question as an archway through which you must pass.
instructions.shuffle: Shuffle the full deck while concentrating on clearing away ambiguity.
instructions.drawing: Deal 7 cards in a semi-circular U-shape starting bottom-left, ascending to apex, and descending right.
instructions.synthesis: Compare the ascent (Cards 1-3) with the pivot (Card 4) and descent/emergence (Cards 5-7).

slots.description: Historical factors that originated the present dilemma.
Where you stand at this exact moment.
Unseen forces, unexamined variables, or latent dynamics.
The crux of the matter: what must be faced or transformed.
How the surrounding world and key peers perceive the issue.
The most effective psychological or practical response to adopt.
The destination reached if the recommended approach is taken.
